cases.title: Poster meaning as neutral physical poster
good_patterns: neutral poster fastened to the door frame with colored tape
plain poster hanging from a small clip on the wardrobe door
notice-board style poster pinned beside the door handle
bad_patterns: drug trafficker, crime cartel, gang, mafia, wanted poster, mugshot
face poster suggesting a criminal or violent story
any sexual, gambling, drug, weapon, horror, or gore association
image_prompt_hints: make the poster itself the cue without readable text
use tape, clip, frame, or blank display backing as safe details

cases.title: Weather or sky concept as crafted indoor mobile
good_patterns: cotton cloud mobile clipped to the chair backrest with paper raindrops
paper raindrops hanging from the lamp shade
small felt sun ornament attached to the window frame
bad_patterns: real sky or outdoor weather photo
vague floating cloud
mood lighting or colored glow as the main clue
image_prompt_hints: name the crafted object and its anchor contact point
avoid concept-only prompts such as cloud over chair

cases.title: Water or landscape concept as contained tabletop proxy
good_patterns: miniature waterfall model pouring into a blue bucket below the air conditioner
small river diorama in a tray on the desk surface
sand tray with shells beside the door
bad_patterns: full outdoor waterfall landscape
forest or beach photo without the anchor
water appearing as a whole-room redesign
image_prompt_hints: use a container such as tray, bowl, bucket, or jar
keep the indoor anchor visible and close to the proxy

cases.title: Large structures as small constructed props
good_patterns: stacked wooden blocks arranged like stair steps on the chair seat
small building model on the desk surface
toy factory model beside the door frame
bad_patterns: real staircase or stairwell
full-size building exterior
palm-sized or hand-sized scale words that may add hands
ambiguous phrase 'block steps' that can read as a block walking
image_prompt_hints: use prop nouns such as stacked blocks, model, toy, or diorama
make the anchor contact point explicit

cases.title: Outdoor or public place as indoor diorama
good_patterns: miniature houses and two neighbor figures on a doormat in front of the door
tiny market stall diorama on the desk surface
small park model in a tray beside the chair leg
bad_patterns: real outdoor city view
dog running through an unseen neighborhood
whole street scene without the assigned anchor
image_prompt_hints: use miniature props and a visible anchor contact surface

cases.title: Container object with visible contents or state
good_patterns: glass jar filled with colorful candies on the floor by the door
bottle tipped beside the desk with visible liquid inside
open box on the shelf with folded cloth inside
bad_patterns: contents spilled outside when the cue says filled inside
empty container when contents are the meaning cue
container alone with no visible state
image_prompt_hints: state whether contents are inside, spilling, empty, sealed, cracked, or open
keep the container and contents both visible

cases.title: Abstract meaning as physical state or contrast
good_patterns: two unequal weights on a small scale on the desk surface
cracked cup beside an intact cup on the shelf
locked box refusing to open on the chair seat
bad_patterns: abstract glow or mood as the main cue
written labels or arrows
explanatory symbolism not visible in the scene
image_prompt_hints: turn the idea into a visible object state, damage state, contrast, or simple interaction

cases.title: Person noun as small figure doing defining behavior
good_patterns: small teacher figure pointing to a tiny chalkboard on the desk
doctor figurine holding a stethoscope beside the chair
neighbor figure waving from a miniature doorway by the door
bad_patterns: large full-room human scene
unclear person without defining behavior
culture-specific joke or obscure reference
image_prompt_hints: use a small figure plus a clear defining action
keep the action next to the assigned anchor
